title: Taking Turns
author: Rashmi Mohapatra/ ରଶ୍ମି ମହାପାତ୍ର
text:
In the courtyard,
two shadows trade their lengths
morning shorter,
evening learning to stoop.

The wind stands
at the curve
of a pause,
waiting to learn
which sorrow will pass first.

A kettle hums
on the brink of speech,
its vapour curling
like a memory
that won`t cool.

Even the pendulum
halts mid-swing,
as if time itself
forgot its direction.

Far away,
a river turns upon itself,
carrying yesterday`s shimmer
into a deeper hush.

Life
a small rotation of breath,
taking turns
to be vessel,
and then,
the thirst it once held.
